title: Neuroglancer
notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). A WebGL viewer in the browser that streams very large EM image volumes, segmentation volumes and neuron meshes over HTTP and shows them together in linked cross-section and 3-D views. Data used in the run: public. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
